subject: Mythology
title: Krishna: The Divine Prankster
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Krishna: The Divine Prankster.

hook.text: Krishna was a butter-stealing child, a flute-playing teenager, and the architect of a world-changing war.

buildup.text: Born in a prison cell to escape a tyrant king, he was smuggled to a village and raised by cowherds.

discovery.text: As a child, his mother asked him to open his mouth. Inside it, she saw the entire universe spinning.

twist.text: He became Arjuna's charioteer in the great war, and his speech became the Bhagavad Gita — Hinduism's most famous text.

climax.text: Krishna taught that doing your duty with detachment is the path to spiritual freedom and eternal peace.

punchline.text: A mischievous cowherd delivered the deepest philosophy in human history.

quiz.question: What text contains Krishna's famous teachings to Arjuna?
